note: Intent router (step R of the main pipeline), after the emergency and safety checks. Nutrition related (sent to the nutrition plugin): foods, dishes, recipes, nutrients, meals, the programme's food rules, and statements about allergies, diet or conditions. Everything else (symptoms, medicines on their own, exercise, sleep, greetings, other topics) is answered by the main assistant. A condition or health word with no food or diet word is unsure: the router asks one question. Word lists are drafts for Swastham to review against real traffic.
clarify_question: Is your question about food or your diet? Say yes and I'll answer it with your food plan, or no and I'll answer it in general.

main_replies.greeting: Hello! I'm the Dixit assistant. Ask me about food, meals, recipes or the programme's food rules.
main_replies.thanks: You're welcome. Ask me any time.
main_replies.about: I'm the Dixit assistant, an automated helper, not a doctor and not a person. I can look up the nutrition of foods and dishes, suggest recipes and explain the Dixit programme's food rules. For medical advice please talk to your doctor.
main_replies.exercise: I can't advise on exercise here. Please ask your Dixit coach or your doctor what activity suits you. I can help with food, meals and recipes.
main_replies.sleep: I can't advise on sleep here. If poor sleep goes on, please talk to your doctor. I can help with food, meals and recipes.
main_replies.medicine: I can't advise on medicines or doses. Please ask your doctor.
main_replies.symptom: I can't judge symptoms. If it continues or gets worse, please talk to your doctor.
main_replies.general: I'm best with food and diet questions, such as what to cook, the calories in a dish, or the programme's food rules. For other topics, please ask your Dixit coach.

noted_line: Thank you for telling me; I've noted it for your food answers.

locked_lines.medicine: Please don't start, stop or change a medicine without your doctor.
locked_lines.symptom: If you feel shaky, sweaty or dizzy, especially if you take diabetes medicine, eat something and contact your doctor.
